items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He plays all those Scott Joplin numbers and everything. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Say it all, man.

ctx.x: Yeah, we play some of that kind of music, you know. My band, my band, we play some of the old music. Play some of that old music. Yeah, but I would be interested, you know, to find... Yeah, yeah. See some of Pete's music.

He plays all those Scott Joplin numbers and everything. Yeah. You remember Scott Joplin's numbers? Who? Scott Joplin! Yeah. Maple Leaf Rag he plays. You remember Maple Leaf? Yeah. He plays all those old numbers in his band. Yeah.
